---

## Repository-Wide Validation Mechanisms

### 1. CI Workflows (`.github/workflows/`)

**`pytest.yml`** — [blob link](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/.github/workflows/pytest.yml)

Triggers on `push` and `pull_request` to `main`/`master`. Runs two separate jobs:

- **`test`**: Python 3.13 only (no matrix sweep). Installs `requirements.test.txt`. Runs:
  - `pytest tests/ -v --cov=... --ignore-glob="**/test_*.py.disabled"` (unit tests, coverage to Codecov)
  - `pytest custom_components/smart_irrigation/tests/test_helpers.py custom_components/smart_irrigation/tests/test_performance.py custom_components/smart_irrigation/tests/test_diagnostics.py` (integration tests, hardcoded file list)
  - Uploads XML coverage to Codecov with `fail_ci_if_error: false` — coverage failures do not block the workflow.
- **`lint`**: Runs `ruff check custom_components/smart_irrigation/ --output-format=github` then `black --check custom_components/smart_irrigation/`. Both are blocking steps. `isort` is installed but not invoked as a separate check step.

**`hacs.yml`** — [blob link](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/.github/workflows/hacs.yml)

Runs on `push`, `pull_request`, and daily cron. Uses `hacs/action@main` to validate HACS integration metadata (`hacs.json`, file structure). No pinned action SHA.

**`hassfest.yml`** — [blob link](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/.github/workflows/hassfest.yml)

Runs on `push`, `pull_request`, and daily cron. Uses `home-assistant/actions/hassfest@master` to validate `manifest.json`, service schemas, and HA integration conventions. No pinned action SHA.

**`stale.yml`** — [blob link](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/.github/workflows/stale.yml)

Daily cron. Labels and closes stale issues and PRs. Issues labelled `do-not-auto-close` or `bug` are exempt.

**`release-zip.yml`** — [blob link](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/.github/workflows/release-zip.yml)

Triggered on GitHub release publication or via `workflow_dispatch`. Packages `custom_components/smart_irrigation/` (excluding `tests/`, `__pycache__/`, `*.pyc`, `frontend/node_modules/`) into `smart_irrigation.zip` and attaches it to the release asset. `hacs.json` has `"zip_release": true` and `"filename": "smart_irrigation.zip"`, activating HACS zip download.

---

### 2. Linter Configuration (`pyproject.toml`)

[blob link](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/pyproject.toml)

`ruff` rule sets enabled: `E` (pycodestyle), `F` (pyflakes), `B` (bugbear), `I` (isort ordering), `UP` (pyupgrade), `SIM` (simplify). Explicitly ignored: `E501` (line length) and `SIM102` (nested `if`). `black` is used separately for formatting. There is no `mypy`, `pylint`, or type-checking step.

---

### 3. pytest Configuration (`setup.cfg`)

[blob link](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/setup.cfg)

```
testpaths = tests custom_components/smart_irrigation/tests
asyncio_mode = auto
asyncio_default_fixture_loop_scope = function
python_files = test_*.py
python_classes = Test*
python_functions = test_*
addopts = -v --tb=short
filterwarnings =
    ignore::DeprecationWarning
    ignore::PendingDeprecationWarning
```

Both `tests/` and `custom_components/smart_irrigation/tests/` are declared as test roots. Asyncio mode is `auto` project-wide. Deprecation warnings are silenced globally.

---

### 4. Dependency Automation (`dependabot.yml`)

[blob link](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/.github/dependabot.yml)

Three ecosystems configured, all targeting the `dev` branch (not `master`):

| Ecosystem | Directory | Schedule | Grouping |
|---|---|---|---|
| `npm` (frontend TypeScript/Lit) | `/custom_components/smart_irrigation/frontend` | weekly | minor+patch grouped into one PR |
| `pip` (Python dev/test deps) | `/` | weekly | none |
| `github-actions` | `/` | weekly | none |

Max 5 open PRs per ecosystem.

---

### 5. Voting Mechanism (`.gitvote.yml`)

[blob link](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/.gitvote.yml)

GitVote is present but **automation is disabled** (`automation.enabled: false`, `rules: []`). The default profile requires 50% pass threshold over 1 week. No `allowed_voters` teams or users are listed, meaning all collaborators vote. The `/vote` command can still be invoked manually on PRs. A `profile1` variant is defined (75% threshold, 1 minute, `team1`) but `team1` is not defined in this repository, making it non-functional as configured.

---

### 6. Ownership (`manifest.json`)

[blob link](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/custom_components/smart_irrigation/manifest.json)

`codeowners` is set to `["@altmenorg", "@jeroenterheerdt"]`. There is no `CODEOWNERS` file in `.github/` or the repository root, so GitHub does not auto-assign reviewers via the CODEOWNERS mechanism; the `manifest.json` field is used by `hassfest` only.

---

### 7. Branch Workflow Convention (`CLAUDE.md`)

[blob link](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/CLAUDE.md)

Documented policy (not enforced by branch protection rules that are inspectable here):
- Work exclusively on `dev`. Do not commit directly to `master`.
- Merge `dev` → `master` only via `git merge --ff-only dev` when a batch is validated.
- HACS release cut only after validation actions pass green.
- Version string must be bumped across three files: `manifest.json`, `const.py`, `frontend/src/const.ts`.

---

### 8. Pre-commit Hooks (`CONTRIBUTING.md`, `requirements-dev.txt`)

[blob link](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/CONTRIBUTING.md)

`pre-commit>=4.6.0` is listed in `requirements-dev.txt`. `CONTRIBUTING.md` instructs `pre-commit install`. However, there is no `.pre-commit-config.yaml` file in the repository at this revision, so hooks are not configured and `pre-commit install` would produce no hooks.

---

### 9. Disabled Tests

Several test files are present but inert:

|---|---|
| `tests/test_continous_updates.py.disabled` | `tests/` |
| `tests/test_continous_updates_edge.py.disabled` | `tests/` |
